The teacher's corrections on this scene:

The system's item in each run:
Run 1: 帮妈妈的工作：帮妈妈做事，After 帮妈妈, use a verb phrase to state what help is given; 的工作 makes it sound as though the help is directed at “Mother’s work” rather than at Mother. [rule: none]
Run 2: 帮妈妈的工作：帮妈妈干活，After 帮妈妈, use a verb phrase to state what help he gives; 干活 means doing work or chores. [rule: none]
Run 3: 帮妈妈的工作：帮妈妈工作，After 帮 + person, use a verb phrase directly; 的 cannot link the person to the action in this structure. [rule: none]

output.reason: All runs identify the incorrect 的 in 帮妈妈的工作 and replace it with an acceptable verb phrase meaning to help Mother work.
